facts.fact: Ghana Link says the Integrated Customs Management System (ICUMS), hosted in its new Kumasi Tier IV data centre, is relied on daily for trade facilitation and revenue processes by GRA Customs, clearing agents, importers, shipping lines and airlines.

note: ICUMS is only named as a system ITAS will link to; nothing stated on declarations or a single window.
Opinion piece names ICUMS and the earlier GCNet single window only as past reform stages; it states no current system status.
The article names ICUMS only as a source of payments affected by a fault and states nothing on declarations.

facts.fact: The article says the GRA Customs Division operates the Integrated Customs Management System (ICUMS), which streamlines customs processes and improves trade facilitation.
Graphic Online reports ICUMS is the main interface used for declarations, classification, valuation and clearing of goods at Ghana's ports of entry.
Ghana Revenue Authority Commissioner-General Anthony Sarpong said the Integrated Customs Management System (ICUMS) has been the backbone of customs processing for over five years.

note: Workshop release names the country as host and participant only; no customs system status stated.

facts.fact: Citi Newsroom reports Ghana's Integrated Customs Management System, introduced in 2020, integrates valuation, classification, risk management and payments in one system, with downtimes the Trade Minister pressed the operator to fix by November 2025.

systems.owner: Ghana Revenue Authority; operated by Ghana Link

note: The capture holds only aggregate survey scores, not the measure-level customs system, single window or exchange.

facts.fact: The ECOWAS Commission says SIGMAT, its interconnected transit-goods system for electronic data exchange between Member States, has been in use by implementing states since 2019, and that a 21-25 July 2025 mission to Ghana resolved the technical and functional challenges hindering transit between Cote d'Ivoire and Ghana.
ECOWAS says Ghana was connected to the SIGMAT goods-in-transit data exchange system for its customs administration in July 2024.

note: Workshop report of SIGMAT status and plans; no dated customs fact for this country that the questions ask.
AI customs automation is stated as an aim only; no system procured, installed or in service.

facts.fact: The Ghana Revenue Authority's ICUMS external user guide describes declarants creating consignment references and lodging and getting bills of entry accepted electronically in the Integrated Customs Management System (date is the published proxy, October 2020).

The guide shows ICUMS external users applying through a Single Window tab for MDA permits attached to their consignment reference before bill of entry creation (date is the published proxy, October 2020).

The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025) that Ghana has a customs online portal that is a single window, linked to the ICUMS external login; no year is given, so the survey round's year is used.
